unit.why: The division is exegesis of the talmudic saying about acquiring the World to Come in one hour, and why Rabbi wept. The Maggid of Mezeritch and his disciple the Seer of Lublin each give an interpretation, and the Maggid approves. The exchange is only a frame for the teaching; no real narrative event takes place.
unit.boundary_note: Opening seems truncated: 'בהיותו בהיכל המגיד... ששמע' lacks its subject and narrator, and the text is garbled in places ('ע״כ כשבא לו איזה שמחה בבה'). Not continuous with the previous division, which ends a separate Lublin teaching on pride.
